_note: Disambiguation-question drafts for symptoms/emotions/behaviours that map to MORE THAN ONE chakra -- i.e. cases where the deterministic scoring engine can't tell which chakra a reported indicator points to without asking a follow-up question. Draft questions were authored by ANAHAT (grounded in the existing questioning-technique guides per the 'Grounded in real source?' column), but the 'Is this a good question?' and 'Your Better Version' columns are 100% UNFILLED (0/38) in the therapist's returned workbook -- this is real, still-open therapist work, not something to fill in automatically. Do NOT treat the draft questions below as approved for use until a therapist has reviewed them.
